label: Fed rate decision (2 p.m. ET) and Chair Warsh press conference; Alphabet and Microsoft earnings after the close
why: A hold at 3.75%-4.00% is expected; any hint of a hike would move bonds, the U.S. dollar, stocks and crypto.

label: U.S. Q3 GDP and September PCE inflation (8:30 a.m. ET); ECB decision; Amazon, Coinbase and Strategy earnings
why: PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge; Coinbase and Strategy results are reads on crypto activity.

label: Bank of Japan decision; large monthly bitcoin options expiry
why: Big options expiries can pull prices toward popular strike levels.

label: Apple earnings (after the close); Bitway (BTW) and Quack AI (Q) token unlocks
why: Apple is the largest index weight; newly unlocked tokens can add selling pressure.

label: U.S. midterm elections; AMD earnings (after the close)
why: The result could shape oil, the Iran conflict and risk appetite.

label: Zcash NU7 upgrade (about 7:50 p.m. ET)
why: Upgrade events often bring sharp price swings.

label: U.S. October jobs report (8:30 a.m. ET)
why: A strong report could push yields higher and raise the odds of a Fed hike.

label: Bank of Canada (9:45 a.m. ET) and Fed (2 p.m. ET) rate decisions
why: Both central banks decide the same day; the Bank of Canada has said more hikes are possible.
